BiblicalUsage: Baalath was a town Solomon built and fortified, in the land he ruled — named with the store-cities and the chariot-cities, and listed again among the towns of Dan's inheritance. A fortified city of the king, on the edge of the hill country.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Solomon's building was real building — cities, walls, storehouses — and Baalath is one of the bricks in the kingdom he was given.
